extensionDescription.message: Connect selected Chrome tabs to Switchboard through a local native helper.

pairInstructions.message: Enter this code in Switchboard to pair this Chrome profile.

pageDisclosure.message: Selected page content is sent to the model in your Switchboard chat.

stopNotice.message: Stop cancels queued actions and detaches Switchboard. It cannot undo completed website actions. Your tabs stay open.

connectionError.message: Connection unavailable. Check Chrome setup in Switchboard.

operationTimedOut.message: Chrome did not finish an action. Resolve any open page dialog, then click Connect. The action will not be retried.

outcomeUnknown.message: This action ID was already dispatched. Observe the page before continuing.

frameInputUnsupported.message: Input in this frame is not supported. Ask the user to interact with it.
